summary: The manuscript presents a rigorous, machine-checked Lean 4.35.0 formalization and exact-rational verification framework for matrix-polynomial open quantum master equations and critical solutions. It establishes 18 zero-sorry theorems, 16 sub-millisecond canonical certificates, and 60/60 adversarial rejections.
